def _match(ls1, vs1, ls2, vs2):
    vs1 = list(vs1)
    vs2 = list(vs2)
    res_l = []
    res_v = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(ls1):
        v = vs1[i] if vs1[i] < vs2[j] else vs2[j]
        res_l.append(ls1[i] + ls2[j])
        res_v.append(v)
        vs1[i] -= v
        vs2[j] -= v
        if vs1[i] == 0:
            i += 1
        if vs2[j] == 0:
            j += 1
    return res_l, res_v


def flatten(edge_map, u, t, c):
    """Return (paths, counts) with sum(counts)==c for logical arc (u,t)."""
    if (u, t) not in edge_map:
        return [[(u, t)], [c]]
    res_paths = []
    res_cs = []
    entries = sorted(edge_map[u, t].items(), key=lambda e: e[1])
    for w, cp in entries:
        if c <= 0:
            break
        if c >= cp:
            del edge_map[u, t][w]
            take = cp
        else:
            edge_map[u, t][w] = cp - c
            take = c
        p1, c1 = flatten(edge_map, u, w, take)
        p2, c2 = flatten(edge_map, w, t, take)
        pp, cc = _match(p1, c1, p2, c2)
        res_paths.extend(pp)
        res_cs.extend(cc)
        c -= take
    if c > 0:
        res_paths.append([(u, t)])
        res_cs.append(c)
    order = sorted(range(len(res_cs)), key=lambda i: -res_cs[i])
    res_paths = [res_paths[i] for i in order]
    res_cs = [res_cs[i] for i in order]
    return res_paths, res_cs
